parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, police targeting or organised violence is documented, and a functioning court struck down sodomy laws in 2022 while reading sex-discrimination protection to include gender identity - a documented institutional remedy. Against that, the dossier is thin on traveller-facing practice: border/document screening, facilities, custody and service access are undocumented open questions, there is no statutory anti-discrimination regime or demonstrated later application of the ruling, and no documented social acceptance to offset the one pre-litigation assault, which alone is weak rate evidence. Lack of domestic legal gender recognition is, per rubric, a resident gap not a visitor exposure absent documented rejection of foreign passports. This is no universal or targeted exposure, but lacks the documented acceptance and operating visitor remedies of the 0.75 tier, placing it in upper elevated risk.
